hero.title: Marine Insurance for Every Shipment
hero.subtitle: AWS OVERSEAS impex arranges marine cargo insurance so your goods are covered against loss, damage, and delay from the moment they leave the factory to the moment they reach your door.

overview.title: Marine Insurance Overview
overview.description: Our marine insurance cover protects your cargo against loss, theft, and damage in transit by sea or air, so a single bad shipment doesn't become a total loss.

items.title: Full Transit Cover
items.description: Protection from the origin warehouse to final destination, not just port to port.

items.title: Fast Claims
items.description: Straightforward claims handling with minimal paperwork delays.

items.title: Flexible Coverage
items.description: Cover scaled to your shipment's declared value.

items.title: Loss & Damage Protection
items.description: Covers theft, breakage, water damage, and non-delivery.

items.title: Expert Support
items.description: Guidance choosing the right policy for your cargo type.

items.title: Worldwide Validity
items.description: Coverage that travels with your shipment across any route.

steps.title: Enquire/Inquire
steps.description: Share shipment value and route details.

steps.title: Choose Coverage
steps.description: Select a policy matched to your cargo and risk.

steps.title: Confirm Policy
steps.description: Approve terms and receive your certificate of insurance.

steps.title: Cargo in Transit
steps.description: Your shipment moves under active cover.

steps.title: Claims Support
steps.description: If something goes wrong, we help you file and settle the claim.

items.question: What does Marine Insurance cover?
items.answer: Loss, theft, and physical damage to your cargo while in transit by sea or air, from pickup to final delivery.

items.question: Is insurance included with every shipment?
items.answer: No, marine insurance is arranged separately based on your cargo's declared value and route.

items.question: How do I file a claim?
items.answer: Contact our team with your shipment and policy details, and we'll guide you through documentation and settlement.

items.question: How do I get a quotation?
items.answer: Submit your shipment details using the Enquire/Inquire form.
